text: This solution, Second Disaster Resilience Improvement Program (Second DRIP) addresses natural catastrophe in Philippines between Government of the Philippines, Local government units (LGUs), Government-owned or -controlled corporations (GOCCs), and Asian Development Bank (ADB). The program was implemented in 2025 and focuses on collaboration, regulation, and raising awareness.
